events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Ada Mercer. My walker lost its regulator; there's a spare packed at your wagon.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: A place in your outfit? You've seen my work. I'll take it.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: A clean fit. Close the vent, build pressure, then shut the feed before testing.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Listen to that. A steady heartbeat, and not a hoof out of place.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Feed's shut itself. Open the vent; we'll give it another try.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: You get the second seat. Try to look impressed before we start moving.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Outer feeds open. Middle bypass shut. Simple—until somebody improves it.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: That's our heartbeat. Follow the lanterns. I'll do the steering; you enjoy the view.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: There. Two seats, one regulator, and not a single apology to the laws of nature.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: One more thing before we call that a successful test drive.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: If the kettle whistles, pretend that was deliberate.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Now home. We should stop while we're still excellent at this.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: Lowry tried to sell me a stake in his rail spur. I offered to sell him a regulator that doesn't exist yet. He didn't see the joke.

events.speaker: ADA
events.text: The Hargroves run good machinery on bad debt. I can fix one of those problems. Not the one they're asking about.
